title: Baha'i New Year's Day.
bodyText: The 21st day of March shall be known as Baha'i New Year's Day, provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-4.5]  Baha'i New Year's Day.  The 21st day of March shall be known as Baha'i New Year's Day, provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday. [L 1971, c 39, §1]
